---
title: "Manhattan Plot"
---

## Overview

This document generates a Manhattan plot displaying genome-wide DNA methylation associations with dementia transitions, annotating CpG sites with genes of potential neurological relevance.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Introduction

Make Manhattan plot to show the significant cg sites.

## Load Data


### Read the dementia-related functions

```{r}
dementia_relevance <- read_rds(here("data/private/gene_dmp_dementia_relevance.rds"))

glimpse(dementia_relevance)
```

### Read the plot-ready data

```{r}
manh_tbl_reduced <- read_rds(here("data/upon_request/manhattan_plot_data.rds"))

glimpse(manh_tbl_reduced)
```

### Prepare X axis

X axis breaks and labels, and point colors

```{r}
axis_set <- 
  manh_tbl_reduced |> 
  group_by(chr) |>
  summarise(
    x_axis_order = median(x_axis_order),
  ) |> 
  mutate(color = rep(c("#276FBF", "#183059"), length(unique(chr)) / 2))

glimpse(axis_set)
```

### Make the plot

```{r}
#| label: make-plot
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
manh_plot <-
  manh_tbl_reduced |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x_axis_order, y = nlog10_p_value,  color = chr)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 0.5) +
  # geom_hline(yintercept = 8, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth = 1.0) +
  annotate("segment", x = min(manh_tbl_reduced$x_axis_order), xend = max(manh_tbl_reduced$x_axis_order), y = 8, yend = 8, color = "darkred", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("label", x = 3000000, y = 8,
  # annotate("label", x = max(manh_tbl_reduced$x_axis_order) + 10000, y = 8,
           label = '"1.0 \u00d7 "*10^-8~(threshold)',  # quoted, or plotmath prints "1"
          #  label = "1.0 %*% 10^{-8}",
           parse = TRUE,
           size = 4,
           hjust = 0,
           vjust = 0.8,
           fill = "darkred",
           colour = "white",
           fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = axis_set$color, guide = "none")

#print(manh_plot)

```

## Process dementia-relevance data

### Make a lite version of dementia-relevance data

```{r}

dementia_relevance_lite <- 
dementia_relevance |> 
  # Lengthen the data by p values
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("p_value"), names_to = "demcat", values_to = "nlog10_p_value", names_prefix = "nlog10_p_value_") |>
  # Relevel the dementia categories
  mutate(demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev")) |>
  # Filter by p value threshold
  filter(nlog10_p_value >= 8) |> 
  # Keep the first row for genes with multiple CpG sites
  slice_head(n = 1, by = great_anno) 

glimpse(dementia_relevance_lite)

```

### Make a cross table of dementia-relevance data

```{r}

dementia_relevance_lite |> 
  gtsummary::tbl_cross(row = demcat, col = closeness_level) 
```

### Make plot-ready dementia-relevance data

```{r}

dementia_relevance_plot <- 
  dementia_relevance_lite |> 
  # Keep the top closeness level
  filter(closeness_level == 1) |>
  # Attach the genes whose closeness level is 2 for normal2mci transition
  bind_rows(dementia_relevance_lite %>% filter(closeness_level == 2, demcat == "normal2mci")) |>
  # Attach the genes whose closeness level is 3 for normal2mci transition
  bind_rows(dementia_relevance_lite %>% filter(closeness_level == 3, demcat == "normal2incid")) |>
  # Sample a few genes whose closeness level is 2 for stable_mci transition
  bind_rows(dementia_relevance_lite %>% filter(closeness_level == 2, demcat == "stable_mci") %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = nlog10_p_value)) |>
  # Sample a few genes whose closeness level is 3 for normal2mci transition
  bind_rows(dementia_relevance_lite %>% filter(closeness_level == 3, demcat == "mci2incid") %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = nlog10_p_value)) |>
  # Sample a few genes whose closeness level is 2 for prevelant dementia
  bind_rows(dementia_relevance_lite %>% filter(closeness_level == 2, demcat == "prev") %>% slice_max(n = 30, order_by = nlog10_p_value)) |>
  # Keep one gene for each CpG site
  slice_head(n = 1, by = cg) |>
  # Get x_axis_order from manh_tbl_reduced
  left_join(select(manh_tbl_reduced, cg, x_axis_order), by = "cg", multiple = "first") |>
  # Arrange by x_axis_order
  arrange(x_axis_order) |>

  # Add a column for plot_order
  mutate(relevance_order = seq(min(manh_tbl_reduced$x_axis_order), max(manh_tbl_reduced$x_axis_order), length.out = n()))

glimpse(dementia_relevance_plot)
```

### Modify dementia-relevance column

```{r}

dementia_relevance_plot_2 <- 
  dementia_relevance_plot |> 
    mutate(
    dementia_relevance_modified = str_c(
      "**", great_anno, ":** ", 
      str_replace(dementia_relevance, "^.*?; ", "")
    )
  ) |>
  # Remove Cerebral Autosomal Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts and Leukoencephalopathy (CADASIL) to shorten the text. Add it to the legend.
  mutate(dementia_relevance_modified = str_remove(dementia_relevance_modified, regex(" *\\(Cerebral Autosomal Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts and Leukoencephalopathy\\)", ignore_case = TRUE)))

glimpse(dementia_relevance_plot_2)
```

### Add dementia-relevance data to the plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12


manh_plot_dementia_relevance <-
manh_plot +
  # Add symbols for selected CpG sites
  geom_point(data = select(dementia_relevance_plot_2, cg, x_axis_order, nlog10_p_value, demcat), 
             aes(x = x_axis_order, y = nlog10_p_value, fill = demcat), shape = 23, size = 3, 
             color = "white", alpha = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add segment for dementia-relevance data
  geom_segment(data = dementia_relevance_plot_2, 
               aes(x = x_axis_order, xend = relevance_order, y = nlog10_p_value, yend = 20), 
               color = "black", alpha = 1, linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add symbols for dementia-relevance data
  geom_point(data = dementia_relevance_plot_2, 
             aes(x = relevance_order, y = 20, fill = demcat), shape = 21, size = 2, 
             color = "black", alpha = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) + 
  # Add text for dementia-relevance data using ggtext::geom_richtext()
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = dementia_relevance_plot_2,
                aes(x = relevance_order + 65000, y = 21, label = dementia_relevance_modified),
                fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                color = "black", angle = 90,
                hjust = 0,
                vjust = -0.3,
                size = 4.5,
                label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"),
                inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Expand the y axis
  scale_x_continuous(name = NULL, label = axis_set$chr, breaks = axis_set$x_axis_order, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression(-log[10]~italic(P)), limits = c(0, 55), breaks = seq(0, 20, 5)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Dementia Transition", override.aes = list(size = 3, shape = 21)), color = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme( 
    legend.position = "bottom",
    #legend.position = c(0, 0.1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    # panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, size = 8, hjust = 1.0, vjust = 2.0),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, vjust = 0.2, hjust = 0.1)
  )

print(manh_plot_dementia_relevance)
```

### Save the plot

```{r}
fs::dir_create(here("dmp/output"))

# Save Manhattan plot
ggsave(
  here("dmp/output/manhattan_plot_dementia_relevance.png"),
  manh_plot_dementia_relevance,
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)


write_rds(manh_plot_dementia_relevance, here("dmp/output/manhattan_plot_dementia_relevance.rds"))

```
